boundary: Previously inspected development OOF predictions only. Bootstrap percentile intervals condition on the saved fitted scores and preserve each fold/class size. They omit model refitting, overlapping training-fold dependence, model selection and population shift; they are not generalization confidence intervals or significance tests. AUC/AP point estimates here are pooled OOF, distinct from the benchmark selection metric of mean fold AUC. Calibration is descriptive; no calibrator or cutoff is fitted. No holdout, test data or raw applicant features are read.
binning: 10 fixed equal-width bins; last bin includes probability 1
